extracted.intended_audience: academic researchers and economists studying the relationship between firm-level publications and patent citations (innovation economists, empirical IO researchers), and research funders interested in measurement of knowledge flows
extracted.subtask_description: Empirical protocol and variable definitions for analyzing how patent citations to scientific publications (internal and external) affect subsequent firm publication and patent output, market value, and related outcomes using firm‑level panel data and IV/lag specifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication count
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication count for firm i in year t, including all publications with at least one author employed by the focal firm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the annual flow input to construct publication stock and outcome measures; publications are drawn from Web of Science (Science Citation Index and Conference Proceedings Citation Index-Science) for 1980-2006.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication stock
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication stock in year t for firm i is calculated by: Publication_stock_t = Pub_t + Publication_stock_{t-1}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publication stock accumulates yearly publication counts to form a cumulative measure used as regressors or dependent variables (often transformed as ln(1+Publication_stock)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent count
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent count in year t for firm i (raw patent flow in that year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent flows are used to build patent stock and other patent-based regressors; patents drawn from NBER 2006 patent data project/PatStat matched to firms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent stock
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent_stock_t = Patent_t + Patent_stock_{t-1}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cumulative patent stock used as a control variable (typically ln(1+Patent_stock)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal citation to publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual flow of internal patent citations to firm's own publications (patent citations from the firm's patents to the firm's publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citation variables typically include patent citations up to year t-1 to publications published up to the same year; often transformed as ln(1+Internal_citation) and lagged (t-1) in regressions.

rubrics_metrics.name: External citations to firm's publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual flow of external patent citations to firm's publications; includes citations by corporate and non-corporate patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used both in aggregate and in weighted variants (SEGMENT, TECH). Typically measured up to t-1 and transformed as ln(1+External_citation). Some specifications restrict external citations to corporate patents only.

rubrics_metrics.name: External citations weighted by SEGMENT (product market proximity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual flow of external patent citations to firm's publications weighted by product market proximity between citing and cited firms (SEGMENT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Product market proximity is computed based on each firm's sales share distribution across operating segments (Compustat operating segments database); used to capture market relatedness of citing patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: External citations weighted by TECH (technology proximity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual flow of external patent citations to firm's publications weighted by technology market proximity between citing and cited firms (TECH).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technology proximity is computed based on each firm's patent share distribution across different technology fields; used to capture technological relatedness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Share of internal citations
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of internal citations to science is defined as the ratio of internal citations from own patents to internal and external citations received by corporate and non-corporate patents, per year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a normalized measure of the extent to which a firm's publications are cited by its own patents relative to total patent citations; used both as main regressor and in interaction terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor-author overlap
rubrics_metrics.description: Share of patents per year with inventors who include at least one author of a publication published by the same firm in the three-year window prior to the patent's grant year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructed to capture personnel overlap between science and invention; used as an explanatory variable and as a basis for IV/first-stage analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market value (Griliches definition) and Tobin's Q
rubrics_metrics.description: Market value per firm-year is defined as the sum of values of common stock, preferred stock, and total debt net of current assets; Tobin’s-Q is defined as the ratio of market value to assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a dependent variable in value regressions; market-value regressions include publication stock (and citation‑weighted variants) along with controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: R&D stock (perpetual inventory method)
rubrics_metrics.description: R&D stock per firm-year is calculated using a perpetual inventory method with a 15 percent depreciation rate: GRD_t = R_t + (1-δ) GRD_{t-1} where δ = 0.15 and R_t is R&D expenditure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R&D stock enters regressions typically in log form (ln(R&D_stock)_t-1) as a control for innovation input; follows Hall et al. (2005).

rubrics_metrics.name: Book value of capital components
rubrics_metrics.description: The book value of capital includes net plant, property and equipment, inventories, investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries, and intangibles other than R&D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in constructing asset measures and Tobin's Q denominator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data sources and coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary data sources: Web of Science (Science Citation Index and Conference Proceedings Citation Index-Science) for publications (1980-2006), NBER 2006 patent data project, PatStat for patent grants and citation matching, U.S. Compustat for financials and operating segments, HBS Patent Inventor Database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publication and patent matching details and coverage windows are documented; publication stock includes WoS publications of sample firms published over 1980-2006; citation matching uses patents granted up to focal year and publications published from 1980 until focal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing/citation window restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Citation variables include patent citations up to year t-1 to publications published up to the same year; in some analyses citations are restricted to publications published no earlier than five years prior to the citing patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This timing ensures citations precede the dependent outcome and avoids contemporaneous reverse causality; different lag windows (1,2,3 years and 5-year cutoff) are reported across tables/figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample restrictions and conditioning (publishing/patenting firms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Many specifications condition on samples such as only patenting firms, publishing firms only, or firms with at least one publication stock over sample period; some analyses restrict firms by survey responses (e.g., main research field from CMS Q22).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results are presented for pooled, between-firms, within-firms, and publishing-firms-only samples; authors report number of firms and observations for each specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard errors and clustering
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard errors are robust to arbitrary heteroscedasticity and allow for serial correlation through clustering by firms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All reported standard errors (in parentheses or brackets) follow this robust clustered approach; significance reported accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zero/absence dummy controls
rubrics_metrics.description: All specifications include dummy variables that receive the value one for firm‑years without publications, without patents, or without citations as appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These dummies control for structural zeros and are included to avoid bias from firms that never publish or never patent during focal years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fixed effects and standard controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifications include firm fixed-effects, 4-digit industry dummies (or industry controls), and year dummies as standard covariates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fixed-effects control for time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity; industry and year dummies control for sectoral/time trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependent variable transformations
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcomes are commonly transformed as ln(1 + variable) (e.g., ln(1+number of publications), ln(1+Publication stock), ln(1+Internal citation), ln(Market value)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Log(1+) transformation handles zero counts and reduces skewness; interpretation is in semi-elasticities or percentage changes for small changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation-weighted patent output
rubrics_metrics.description: Patents are weighted by forward citations when constructing the dependent variable 'citation-weighted patents' (ln(1+Number of citation-weighted patents)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This weights more influential patents more heavily in patent-production regressions; used in Table 9 to relate internal use to patent output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instrumental variable: IDD-Mobility
rubrics_metrics.description: IDD-Mobility is an instrument equal to the status of the Inevitable Disclosure Doctrine (IDD) being effective (1/0) in the firm's state-year multiplied by a mobility risk measure based on the number of publishing firms within 100 miles in the same industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an instrument for internal citation to publications to address endogeneity; first-stage and 2SLS results are reported including Kleibergen-Paap/weak id diagnostics and F-statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instrumental variable: Devaluation dummy
rubrics_metrics.description: Devaluation dummy is based on weighted changes in exchange rates in countries where the firm has subsidiaries; used as an instrument in IV specifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used (alone or together with IDD) as an instrument for internal citations in IV analyses for publishing firms; robustness checks include overidentification (Hansen) tests and Stock-Yogo critical values.

rubrics_metrics.name: IV diagnostic and weak identification reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Report weak identification diagnostics (Kleibergen-Paap), first-stage F-statistics, Stock-Yogo critical values, overidentification Hansen test, and related statistics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required to assess instrument strength and validity; tables report F, Kleibergen-Paap values, and whether they exceed critical thresholds (e.g., Stock-Yogo CV 5%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Lag specification and robustness to different lags
rubrics_metrics.description: Main regressions use lagged citation and stock variables (t-1) and present robustness checks for lag 1, lag 2, lag 3; IVs often instrument lagged internal citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors present OLS and IV results for different lags to check persistence and timing of effects; results across lags reported in Table A4 and others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heterogeneous effects and subgroup analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinguish citation effects by types: NEW vs OLD science, BASIC vs APPLIED publications (JIF/CHI), High vs Low quality publications/patents, CORE vs NON-CORE technology, industry-specific analyses (by SIC groups).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run separate regressions or interacted specifications to test heterogeneity; report difference-of-coefficients significance levels and subgroup sample sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Matching procedure for internal vs external citation identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Internal citation identified when patent owner and cited corporate publication are the same firm; external citation when patent owner and cited corporate publication are different firms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Matching examples and flow (Figure A5) document the matching logic used to classify citations as internal or external.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication weighting in market-value regressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication stock is sometimes weighted by internal and external patent citations (and by SEGMENT/TECH proximities) when relating publication stock to market value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Column variants use raw publication stock or citation-weighted stocks; external-cited publication stock is weighted by product and technology proximity between citing patent and cited publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting standards in tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables report coefficient estimates with robust clustered standard errors in parentheses, indicate included fixed effects/dummies, show dependent-variable sample averages, number of firms, observations, and R-squared.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow this format for transparency and comparability across specifications; also report significance and sample descriptions in table notes.
